Understanding Foot Massage and Reflexology

Foot massage involves applying pressure to the feet through kneading, stroking, and manipulation of the soft tissues. It can be performed by a professional, a partner, or yourself using simple techniques. The feet contain over 7,000 nerve endings, more than 100 muscles, tendons, and ligaments, and 26 bones each, making them incredibly responsive to targeted touch.

Foot reflexology is a more specialized discipline. It operates on the principle that specific points on the feet correspond to different organs, glands, and systems in the body. Reflexology maps divide the foot into distinct zones — the toes correspond to the head and brain, the ball of the foot to the chest and lungs, the arch to digestive organs, and the heel to the lower back and intestines. Which she was great at identifying. She was relentless, her hands were smooth. She knew the good stuff and what she was doing. Thank you Daisy you were a blessing :)
This place is to be gone to if you wanna put on those rose tinted glasses when it comes to ambience and feeling special. And just nose dive to what the therapist does. Especially if it were Daisy. The 4 rating is literally only for her :)
